content.value: Every 1 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]] grants +2 maximum health. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]] is used for heavy equipment requirements and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]]-aligned armour runes.

Every 1 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]] grants +2 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:evasion_rating|evasion rating]]. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]] supports leather/evasion bases, bow requirements, speed, projectile play, and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]]-aligned armour runes.

Every 1 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]] grants +2 maximum mana. [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]] supports [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]], elemental/ailment routes, and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]-aligned armour runes.

Each equipment tooltip lists its exact Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence requirements. Check these before changing gear, especially when replacing an item that supplies attributes needed by another piece. Materials and equipment types can require different attribute combinations. See [[article/rarity_requirements|Item Requirements]] for penalties and reduction effects.
Reduced Requirements runes multiply each nonzero requirement down and round it to the nearest whole point. Failing any required attribute reduces item-derived stats by 50%.

Tools—axes, pickaxes, shovels, and hoes—have no primary-attribute requirements and cannot receive rune affixes. Their progression uses compatible enchantments and [[item/cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil|Deepslate Sigil]] slots instead.
